remaining_exact_source_patches.after:
def derive_packet(prior_raw):
    delta=PACKET_DELTA
    checked(prior_raw,delta["base"],"actual successful57 complete packet")
    packet=strict(prior_raw)
    need(packet["schema"]==delta["schema_before"]
         and packet["current_aggregate"]==delta["aggregate_before"]
         and "main58_successor" not in packet,"exact actual57 packet predecessor")
    matches=[item for item in packet["files"] if item["path"]==delta["composition"]["path"]]
    need(len(matches)==1 and len(packet["files"])==6,"one existing composition and six prior fixtures")
    item=matches[0]
    original=dict(item)
    before=item["raw_utf8"].encode("utf-8","strict")
    checked(before,delta["composition"]["before"],"actual57 composition raw")
    after=before.decode("utf-8","strict")
    need(len(delta["composition"]["ordered_replacements"])==2
         and delta["changed_production_inputs"]==[],"two composition hooks; all44 full production rows unchanged")
    for hunk in delta["composition"]["ordered_replacements"]:
        need(hunk["count"]==1 and after.count(hunk["before"])==1,"unique composition hook")
        after=after.replace(hunk["before"],hunk["after"])
    exact_changes(before,delta["composition"]["ordered_replacements"],after.encode("utf-8"))
    checked(after.encode("utf-8"),delta["composition"]["after"],"current composition exact raw")
    item.update(delta["composition"]["after"]);item["raw_utf8"]=after
    item["ordered_replacements"]=item["ordered_replacements"]+delta["composition"]["ordered_replacements"]
    helper=delta["new_helper"]
    need(helper["path"] not in [f["path"] for f in packet["files"]],"new external helper cannot shadow a prior fixture")
    checked(helper["raw_utf8"].encode("utf-8"),helper,"exact observation-settle helper")
    packet["files"].append(helper)
    packet["schema"]=delta["schema_after"]
    packet["current_aggregate"]=delta["aggregate_after"]
    packet["main58_successor"]=delta["added_metadata"]
    raw=encoded(packet)
    checked(raw,delta["result"],"complete current packet full pin")
    reverse=strict(raw)
    need(reverse["files"].pop()==helper,"only one appended helper")
    rows=[f for f in reverse["files"] if f["path"]==item["path"]]
    need(len(rows)==1,"unique reverse composition")
    rows[0].clear();rows[0].update(original)
    reverse["schema"]=delta["schema_before"]
    reverse["current_aggregate"]=delta["aggregate_before"]
    del reverse["main58_successor"]
    need(encoded(reverse)==prior_raw,"whole actual57 packet remains byte-identical")
    return raw,packet
